title: 第3章 发财后被人盯上了第4章 第一次杀人
slug: 聚灵飞升第1126章暗流之下
content_zh:
云昊从药笼拿出草叶子包裹的人参，打开放在了柜台上。
掌柜原本还有些漫不经心的表情，瞬间一亮。
拿起人参仔细观摩。
一会儿后，脸上笑意更浓，看着云昊道：“这是我见过根须最为全乎的人参，小兄弟挖药手艺老道，竟是一根细微的根须都没断。”
对掌柜的夸奖，云昊憨厚一笑，没有说话。
心里却在说，我哪有什么手艺！
根须全乎，都是宝瓶的功劳。
藏在怀中的宝瓶，拥有断肢重生的之能，只不过“生”
的是人参断肢。
看着掌柜脸上的笑容，他知道这把稳妥了。
人参，掌柜的定然会收。
就是不知道会给一个什么价儿。
对此云昊有些期待。
只听掌柜道：“这株人参年份在六年有余，按说寻常六年份的人参，也就值个二两半银子。
但小兄弟这株人参品相非常完好，这年头采药不易，老夫也不亏你，给你三两银钱可好？”
砰砰砰……
云昊听到三两银子，心都跳了起来。
对食不果腹的他来说实在是……天价！
街上一文钱可以买个大肉包子，半斤粗盐巴。
十文钱一升米，省着吃够吃好些天。

一两银子可是一千文钱，三两银子就是足足三千文。
这是一笔巨款。
心里直呼发财了。
掌柜看云昊不说话以为是嫌少了，忍不住出声道：“小兄弟三两银子已经不少了，你可以去其它药坊打听打听，整个星河镇我们杏林坊绝对给的是最高价。”
云昊哪是什么嫌少，实在是三两银子对他的冲击太大，愣住了而已。
连忙道：“成交。”
“好，爽快，你要银子？还是钱吊子？”
掌柜问道。
说完怕云昊山野小子不懂，便解释道：“一两银子等于一吊钱，一吊钱是一千文钱，零散的钱吊子好花销。”
“三吊钱！”
云昊道。
其实他知道钱币的换算，以前老道爷教过他。
从杏林坊出来，云昊怀里鼓鼓的。
人参卖了三吊钱，就像做梦一般。
有了这笔钱，他和姐姐今年饿不死了，并且还能吃饱。
接下来就是改善生活。
首先来到了包子铺。
香喷喷的大肉包子，他从来没吃过。
content_en:
Yunhao took out the ginseng wrapped in grass leaves from the medicine cage, opened it and placed it on the counter.
The shopkeeper's initially careless expression suddenly brightened.
Pick up the ginseng and observe it carefully.
After a while, the smile on his face grew stronger, and he looked at Yun Hao and said, "This is the ginseng with the most complete roots I have ever seen. The little brother is so skilled at digging the medicine that not a single tiny root has been broken."
Yun Hao smiled honestly at the shopkeeper's compliment and said nothing.
But I was saying in my heart, I don’t have any skills!
The root and hair are all due to the Aquarius.
The treasure bottle hidden in the arms has the power to regenerate broken limbs, but it is only "resurrected"
It's a severed ginseng limb.
Looking at the smile on the shopkeeper's face, he knew it was a safe bet.
Ginseng, the shopkeeper will definitely accept it.
I just don’t know what the price will be.
Yunhao has some expectations for this.
The shopkeeper said: "This ginseng is more than six years old. Normally, a six-year-old ginseng is worth two and a half taels of silver.
But little brother, this ginseng plant is in very good condition. It’s not easy to collect medicine these days. I won’t lose you. Can I give you three taels of silver? "
Bang bang bang...
Yun Hao's heart skipped a beat when he heard the three taels of silver.
For him who was hungry, it was really... a sky-high price!
A penny on the street can buy a big meat bun and half a pound of coarse salt.
Ten cents a liter of rice, enough to last for several days.
One tael of silver is equivalent to one thousand cash, and three taels of silver is equivalent to three thousand cash.
This is a huge amount of money.
I felt like I was getting rich.
Seeing Yun Hao's silence, the shopkeeper thought it was too little, so he couldn't help but said: "Little brother, three taels of silver is already a lot. You can go to other medicine shops to inquire. We at Xinglin Fang definitely give the highest price in the entire Xinghe Town."
Yun Hao didn't think it was too little, it was just the three taels of silver that had such a huge impact on him that he was stunned.
He quickly said: "Deal."
"Okay, cool, do you want money? Or do you want money?"
the shopkeeper asked.
After saying this, he was afraid that the wild boy Yunhao would not understand, so he explained: "One tael of silver is equal to one ounce of money, and one ounce of money is one thousand Wen. The scattered money is easy to spend."
"Three ounces of money!"
Yun Hao said.
In fact, he knew the conversion of coins. The old Taoist taught him before.
Coming out of Xinglinfang, Yunhao's arms were bulging.
Ginseng was sold for three ounces of money, just like a dream.
With this money, he and his sister will not starve to death this year and will still have enough to eat.
The next step is to improve your life.
First we came to the bun shop.
He had never eaten the delicious meat buns.
